ruling.recommended_action: Issue a Ryde voucher of SGD 3.24 to the rider (unexempt detour ~2.30 km at SGD 1.41/km), and record the RD-1 breach on the driver's file. No account flag: driver's 90-day route disputes upheld = 0, so RD-6 is not triggered.
ruling.reasoning:
Service type is RydeTAXI, so the trip is metered: extra distance directly inflates the fare (policy §0, RD-2). Rider complaint = driver left the quoted route silently; driver says "GPS rerouted" — no traffic justification is on the record (traffic.incidents = [], speed bands on the route are band 5, i.e. free flow, so RD-4 gives no exemption). Chat contains only a pickup arrangement (black backpack / blue Prius) — nothing before the deviation, so RD-5 consent does not exist; the driver's claim of GPS rerouting is not rider consent.

Route reconstruction: the driver followed the quoted polyline from Raffles Place through the ECP corridor (matches polyline points up to ~1.2960,103.8950). A first divergence appears between the 09:24:00 sample (1.30809,103.93088) and 09:24:30 (1.309079,103.933754), where the driver passed south of and then north of the ECP alignment around 1.3102–1.3112,103.9340–103.9350 (quoted route runs 1.3093,103.93514 → 1.31044,103.93924). The GPS then runs off the line for ~11 minutes: 09:25:00 1.311484,103.934355; 09:25:30 1.314159,103.934176; 09:26:00 1.315803,103.935313; 09:26:30 1.314501,103.936773; roughly 1–2.5 km west of the quoted corridor, returning to the quoted line at ~09:31:00–09:31:30 (1.311826,103.94526 / 1.31189,103.94831 vs route 1.31133,103.94231 / 1.31182,103.94498). The deviation is therefore an out-and-back loop west of the quoted route.

Length of the unexempt segment: the driven path along those GPS points is ~6.6 km, while the quoted route between the same endpoints (approx. 1.3095,103.9352 → 1.3119,103.9449) is ~1.12 km straight / ~1.3 km by road. Using the fare record's excess (fare.distance_km 24.41 − route 21.21 = 3.20 km extra) and subtracting ~0.9 km attributable to the 200 m corridor/map-matching jitter and the ramp re-join at 1.31236,103.95178, the unexempt segment contributes ~2.30 km of extra distance.

Amount: RydeTAXI distance rate = fare.distance_fare ÷ fare.distance_km = 34.42 ÷ 24.41 = SGD 1.4101/km. Refund = 2.30 × 1.4101 = SGD 3.24 (rounded to the cent). Only mileage is refunded; waiting time is not in dispute and nothing else was added (tolls 0, no add-ons), so the rest of the metered fare stands. No RD-3 rider-named stop exists (the record shows no stop the rider asked for), and RD-6 is not met (route_disputes_upheld_90d = 0), so no account flag. No safety content anywhere in the chat, complaint or driver statement; evidence (GPS + quote + fare record) is sufficient, the thinned-but-continuous trace covers the whole trip.

segment_findings.reason: Driver left the quoted ECP corridor between ~09:24:30 and ~09:31:00 and drove a ~6.6 km out-and-back loop west of the route (GPS 1.3142,103.9342 / 1.3158,103.9353 etc.) where the quoted line runs ~1.1–1.3 km; ~2.30 km of extra distance after removing 200 m corridor/jitter mileage. No rider consent before the deviation (chat has only pickup messages, RD-5), no traffic incident on the substituted stretch and speed bands are band 5 free flow (RD-4 (c)), no rider-named stop (RD-3). RD-1/RD-2: unexempt detour, mileage refundable.

rejected_claims.reason: "The GPS sent me; it rerouted" is not rider consent under RD-5 (only the rider's own message sent before the deviation counts) and is offered by the driver, not the rider. It also does not qualify as a reasonable cause under RD-4: no traffic incident falls on the substituted stretch and the LTA speed bands on the route are band 5 (free flow).

The complaint asks for the whole extra distance (3.20 km), but part of the gap between the quoted 21.21 km and the metered 24.41 km is corridor/map-matching jitter and ramp re-join mileage that RD-2 does not refund; only the unexempt segment's ~2.30 km is refundable.
